description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Upload' controller class within the OpenCart admin tools namespace. It manages upload-related functionalities including listing uploads, downloading files, deleting uploads, and handling user permissions. The class methods facilitate interactions with the upload data model, generate views, and handle HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Controller class for managing file uploads in the OpenCart admin area, supporting listing, downloading, and deleting uploads.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the upload management view, initializes breadcrumb navigation, and prepares data for rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a rendered view with a list of uploads, supporting pagination and filtering.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates a filtered and paginated list of upload records based on request parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected uploads, including permission checks and file removal.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Facilitates downloading a specific uploaded file identified by a code parameter.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file upload, including permission check, validation, saving, and JSON response.
